mission: Build Universal Round U.2 as the second universal-design layer for MathTeach, grounding transfer, situated learning, collaborative learning, zone-of-proximal-development reasoning, and adult learning before mathematics-specific specialization.
collection_principles: Prefer foundational and highly cited sources that can change tutor behavior around transfer, help calibration, collaboration, and adult learners.
Translate U.2 evidence into concrete tutoring rules for example variation, analogical comparison, guided participation, and context-sensitive explanation.
Preserve the local, low-friction, non-therapeutic character of the tutor while expanding its universal instructional range.
Use adult-learning theory as an early architectural input because the target product explicitly includes university learners and adult self-learners.

domains.name: Transfer and Generalization
domains.goal: Help the tutor move learners from one solved case toward principled use across new contexts.

domains.name: Situated Learning
domains.goal: Ground explanation in practices, contexts, and authentic use rather than isolated exercise forms alone.

domains.name: Collaborative Learning
domains.goal: Support tutor behaviors that can model, prepare, or simulate cooperative and socially shared learning.

domains.name: Zone of Proximal Development and Guided Participation
domains.goal: Calibrate help to what the learner can almost do, rather than giving either too much or too little support.

domains.name: Adult Learning
domains.goal: Adapt instruction for self-directed, experience-rich, relevance-sensitive adult learners.

starter_sources.title: When and Where Do We Apply What We Learn? A Taxonomy for Far Transfer
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Major framework for distinguishing transfer conditions and preventing naive one-number thinking about far transfer.

starter_sources.title: Toward a Model of Transfer as Sense-Making
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Strong model for treating transfer as context-sensitive sense-making rather than mere reuse of a stored procedure.

starter_sources.title: Reasoning and Learning by Analogy
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Foundational source for analogy as a route to abstraction and transfer, directly relevant to mathematics explanation design.

starter_sources.title: Situated Learning: Legitimate Peripheral Participation
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Canonical foundation for learning as participation in social practice, not just internal knowledge accumulation.

starter_sources.title: Mind in Society: The Development of Higher Psychological Processes
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Primary anchor for the zone of proximal development and the role of socially mediated learning.

starter_sources.title: Cognitive Apprenticeship: Teaching the Craft of Reading, Writing, and Mathematics
starter_sources.organization: Center for the Study of Reading
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Bridges guided participation, modeling, coaching, articulation, and reflection into concrete teaching design.

starter_sources.title: An Educational Psychology Success Story: Social Interdependence Theory and Cooperative Learning
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Strong synthesis on cooperative learning, social interdependence, and the instructional conditions under which collaboration helps.

starter_sources.title: The Adult Learner
starter_sources.date_label: classic andragogy line; current editions continue
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Primary anchor for adult learning as self-directed, experience-rich, relevance-sensitive, and problem-centered.

starter_sources.title: Learning in Adulthood: A Comprehensive Guide
starter_sources.why_it_matters: Broad synthesis for adult learning theory and practice, useful to avoid reducing adult learning to one andragogy slogan.
